ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Convert the system of inequalities into half-planes: x+y-3≥0 gives y≥3-x; x-y+1≥0 gives y≤x+1; 3x-y-5≤0 gives y≥3x-5. The three boundary lines are respectively y=3-x, y=x+1, and y=3x-5. Find the pairwise intersections: y=3-x and y=x+1 intersect at (1,2); y=x+1 and y=3x-5 intersect at (3,4); y=3-x and y=3x-5 intersect at (2,1). These three points all satisfy the corresponding third inequality, so region M is the triangle with vertices (1,2), (3,4), and (2,1). If the line y=kx passes through a point inside region M, then k=y/x. The x-coordinates of all points in region M are positive, so the slopes from the origin to points in M form a continuous interval, and the endpoints are given by the extreme rays passing through the vertices of the triangle. The slopes corresponding to the three vertices are: at (1,2), k=2/1=2; at (3,4), k=4/3; at (2,1), k=1/2. Therefore the minimum value is 1/2, the maximum value is 2, and the boundary points belong to region M, so the range of values of k is [1/2,2].

Find the polygon M by intersecting boundary pairs: y=3-x with y=x+1 gives (1,2); y=x+1 with y=3x-5 gives (3,4); y=3-x with y=3x-5 gives (2,1). Check these satisfy the third inequality, so M is the triangle with these vertices. Since y=kx passing through a point of M means k=y/x for some point in the triangle, and all x-coordinates in M are positive, the possible slopes from the origin to points of M form a continuous interval whose endpoints occur at extreme supporting rays through vertices. method.CoT_raw: 将不等式组化为半平面：x+y-3≥0 得 y≥3-x；x-y+1≥0 得 y≤x+1；3x-y-5≤0 得 y≥3x-5。三条边界线分别为 y=3-x、y=x+1、y=3x-5。求两两交点：y=3-x 与 y=x+1 相交于 (1,2)；y=x+1 与 y=3x-5 相交于 (3,4)；y=3-x 与 y=3x-5 相交于 (2,1)。这三个点都满足相应的第三个不等式，所以区域 M 是以 (1,2)、(3,4)、(2,1) 为顶点的三角形。若直线 y=kx 经过区域 M 内的点，则 k=y/x。区域 M 中所有点的 x 坐标均为正，因此从原点到 M 中点的斜率构成连续区间，端点由经过三角形顶点的极端射线给出。三个顶点对应斜率为：在 (1,2) 处 k=2/1=2；在 (3,4) 处 k=4/3；在 (2,1) 处 k=1/2。所以最小值为 1/2，最大值为 2，且边界点属于区域 M，故 k 的取值范围为 [1/2,2]。

method.method_draft: Use a direct feasibility-in-k route. Substitute y=kx into the three inequalities, because the line y=kx passes through M exactly when there exists a real x satisfying all three resulting inequalities. This gives (1+k)x>=3, (1-k)x>=-1, and (3-k)x<=5. Analyze these inequalities as interval constraints on x for each k. Equivalently, require the lower bounds on x not to exceed the upper bounds, taking care of sign changes in coefficients. The feasible k values are bounded when the line through the origin is just tangent to the feasible region, which occurs when two of the original inequalities are simultaneously active after substitution. Solve the boundary cases: intersection of y=3-x and y=x+1 gives point (1,2), hence k=2; intersection of y=3-x and y=3x-5 gives point (2,1), hence k=1/2. The remaining vertex gives k=4/3, lying between them. The interval feasibility check then yields all k between the two endpoint values, so k in [1/2,2].
method.CoT_raw: 将直线 y=kx 代入不等式组。三条不等式分别化为：(1+k)x>=3，(1-k)x>=-1，(3-k)x<=5。要求直线 y=kx 经过区域 M 内的点，等价于存在实数 x 同时满足这三个关于 x 的不等式。按 k 分类看：当 -1<k<1 时，第一、二、三式给出 x>=3/(1+k)，x>=-1/(1-k)，x<=5/(3-k)，其中主要条件为 3/(1+k)<=5/(3-k)，解得 k>=1/2，所以得到 [1/2,1)。当 k=1 时，条件为 x>=3/2 且 x<=5/2，可行。当 1<k<3 时，条件为 x>=3/(1+k)，x<=1/(k-1)，x<=5/(3-k)，主要限制 3/(1+k)<=1/(k-1)，解得 k<=2，所以得到 (1,2]。当 k<=-1 或 k>2 时，相应上下界不相容，不可行。因此可行 k 的并集为 [1/2,2]。也可从边界验证：y=3-x 与 y=x+1 交于 (1,2)，斜率 k=2；y=3-x 与 y=3x-5 交于 (2,1)，斜率 k=1/2；另一顶点 (3,4) 的斜率为 4/3，在二者之间，所以端点确为 1/2 与 2。
